scope: GEO catalog metadata; file payloads, biological independence and cross-assay pairing not verified

title: Aberrant Transitional Alveolar Epithelial Cells Promote Pathogenic Activation of Lung Fibroblasts in Preclinical Fibrosis Modeling (scRNAseq)
overall_design: To enrich for EPCAM+ cells and mesenchymal cells , a single cell suspension was prepared by physical and enzymatic dissociation (Collagenase, DNase, Dispase) from Sftpc mutation firbosis lungs (n=2) and control lungs (n=2) followed by MACS sorting by LS columns with CD45+ and CD31 cell removal using CD45 and CD31 micobeads followed by EPCAM+ cell enrichment using EPCAM microbeads. CD45-/CD31-/EPCAM- cells were considered lung mesenchymal cells. EPCAM+ and mesenchymal cells were prepared in 50/50 concentration for sequencing.
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing

title: Sftpc_WT_1
extract_protocol_ch1: A single cell suspension was prepared by physical and enzymatic dissociation (Collagenase, DNase, Dispase) followed by MACS sorting by LS columns with CD45+ and CD31 cell removal using CD45 and CD31 micobeads followed by EPCAM+ cell enrichment using EPCAM microbeads. CD45-/CD31-/EPCAM- cells were considered lung mesenchymal cells. EPCAM+ and mesenchymal cells were prepared in 50/50 concentration for sequencing.
Libraries were prepared using Illumina stranded total RNA with Ribo-zero Plus kit accordine to manufacture instructions
data_processing: Fastq files were aligned to the mm10 reference genome using STARSolo
Downstream processing was performed using Seurat v3
Supplementary files format and content: Seurat processed h5 files
